question: Is signed aligned weight error, a = E[(w_norm - w_hat_norm) * L(lambda*)] evaluated at the oracle threshold, the coordinate in which excess marginal risk under estimated-ratio Proposition 2 is one-dimensional? The misspecification sweep produced alignment as a side effect of realistic estimator failures; here it is manipulated directly with synthetic estimators built from the oracle ratio (tempering w^gamma and directional w*exp(delta*x_tilt)), and the 30 misspecification cells are recomputed from their seeds to extract the aligned error their run did not record.

predictions.P1: Tempering traces a monotone path through the oracle: mean excess risk decreases in gamma at both beta levels with no adjacent inversion exceeding 2 combined SE; the gamma=0 endpoint reproduces the registered shift-response unweighted arm within 3 combined SE (0.1920 at beta 0.75, 0.2737 at beta 1.25); gamma=1 is equivalent to oracle (90% CI of paired difference inside [-0.005, +0.005]); gamma=1.5 is conservative (mean excess < 0) at both betas. Directional: delta<0 (under-correction) is anti-conservative with excess rising in |delta|; delta>0 is conservative.
predictions.P2: THE BIG ONE. Pooled across the 30 recomputed misspecification cells and the 28 synthetic cells (58 total), excess marginal risk vs signed aligned error collapses onto one monotone curve: Spearman rho >= 0.9 over cell means, and at least 90% of cells have |residual from the pooled unweighted isotonic fit| <= max(3*SE_cell, 0.0075). If this holds, aligned error is the one-dimensional coordinate and WP2's target functional is identified.
predictions.P3: Internal consistency: temper gamma=0.8 and directional delta=-0.25 at beta=1.25 define the same normalized estimator (effective tilt 1.0); their mean risks agree within 2 combined SE. Both families are exponential-family tilts, so this coincidence is exact in the estimator and any disagreement beyond noise is a harness bug (streams or normalization).
predictions.P4: |aligned error| <= L1 in every cell by arithmetic; any violation is a code bug, not a finding. B*L1 remains a valid envelope in all synthetic cells. Cells with large L1 but small or negative aligned error are exactly the conservative ones, which is why the L1 envelope is loose.
predictions.P5: The oracle arm is CONSISTENT in every synthetic cell (theorem-backed). The misspec recompute reproduces every stored estimated-arm cell mean within 1e-9 (deterministic replay on the same machine).

falsifiers.P1: Non-monotone tempering, or a gamma=0 endpoint away from the unweighted arm, implicates the synthetic-estimator harness (scale invariance of lhat_prop2, normalization) before any scientific reading.
falsifiers.P2: If Spearman < 0.9 or the residual criterion fails, aligned error at the oracle threshold is NOT sufficient as the one-dimensional coordinate. The residual structure (which cells deviate and in which direction) names the missing term, e.g. second-order threshold response or ESS/dispersion effects, and that term becomes the WP2 target instead. This outcome is informative, not a failure of the experiment.
falsifiers.P3: Coincidence failure at matched effective tilt is a bug by construction; the run cannot be interpreted until it is found.
falsifiers.P5: Replication drift above tolerance aborts the run; the recompute may not be quoted if the assertion was loosened for any cell.

decision_rule: Per cell, on mean realized marginal error mass across trials, one-sided z = 1.645: VIOLATION if mean - z*SE > alpha; CONSISTENT WITH CONTROL if mean + z*SE <= alpha + 0.005; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. Failure to establish violation is never reported as evidence of control. Oracle-tracking is an equivalence claim: 90% CI of the paired difference inside [-0.005, +0.005]. Collapse verdict from the preregistered criteria in the config (Spearman >= 0.9 AND residual pass fraction >= 0.9, unweighted isotonic fit on cell means). Primary endpoint: marginal error mass P(commit AND wrong). Placeholder-environment pilot: raw verdicts, exploratory, no Bonferroni, no paper claim rests on this run.
notes: Placeholder environment (synth2); pilot evidence tier. Synthetic cells are rung 1 (exact analytic tilt). The misspecification recompute is analysis tier: identical rng streams and draw order as fa8459eb3cb50722, verified per cell by the 1e-9 assertion against the archived results; the archived artifact directory is never modified. Synthetic-cell rng uses SeedSequence entropy [seed, family_seed_offset + family_idx, setting_idx, beta_millis] with family_seed_offset = 10 so no stream collides with the misspecification cells. Aligned error is defined at the trial's mean oracle threshold; this choice is preregistered and its adequacy is itself under test in P2. The runner accepts --smoke N (synthetic cells only, recompute skipped) for pipeline debugging; smoke outputs are suffixed and never cited.
